events.title: Ota Fureai Festa
events.venue: Omori Furusato-no-Hamaibe Park, Boat Race Heiwajima, Heiwajima Park, and Heiwa-no-Mori Park
events.summary: This large community festival features local foods, stage performances, street entertainment, trampolines, and a petting zoo.

events.title: Wakaba-no-Ite Children's Festival
events.summary: Children can enjoy food stalls, games, events, and freshly baked bread at this community center festival.

events.title: Peace Prayer Fireworks
events.summary: Around five thousand fireworks light up the sky in a prayer for world peace.
